rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality blastocyst consistent with 1DD, noting absent/degenerative ICM and TE and possible collapse; minor limitation is some uncertainty and limited detail on zona/expansion.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, semen quality, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status well, and explains how these interact with poor embryo morphology to shape prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with prognosis appropriately tied to age and 1DD morphology; slight softness comes from broad caveats and some speculative discussion around hydrosalpinx and fresh-vs-frozen effects.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: realistic counseling, single embryo transfer, hydrosalpinx evaluation, selective PGT-A discussion, and uterine cavity assessment; minor deviations include somewhat broad endorsement of transfer despite very poor morphology.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including hydrosalpinx exclusion, counseling, cavity evaluation, and selective further testing; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
